<?php declare(strict_types=1);
namespace Kulturhus\Verein;
use PDO;use DomainException;use DOMDocument;
/** Explicit CORE file preparation. No provider submission and no assumed paid status. */
final class SepaOrders
{
 public function __construct(private PDO $db,private string $actor,private MemberBankVault $vault){}
 private function q(string $sql,array $args=[]):\PDOStatement{return DocumentCatalog::query($this->db,$sql,$args);}
 public function canManage():bool{try{$this->access();return true;}catch(DomainException){return false;}}
 public function canSend():bool{return $this->canManage();}
 private function access():array{$a=Permissions::actor($this->db,$this->actor);FinancePaymentAuthority::require($this->db,$this->actor);return $a;}
 private function tx(callable $work):mixed{$this->db->beginTransaction();try{$v=$work();$this->db->commit();return $v;}catch(\Throwable $e){$this->db->rollBack();throw $e;}}
 private function audit(string $action,string $id,int $version):void{$a=$this->access();$this->q('INSERT INTO audit_events(club_id,actor_id,action,object_id,object_version,happened_at) VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?)',[$a['club_id'],$a['id'],$action,$id,$version,gmdate('c')]);}
 private function office(string $actor):array{return FinancePaymentAuthority::require($this->db,$actor);}
 public function orders():array{$a=$this->access();return $this->q('SELECT id,collection_date,state,total_cents,version,created_at,bank_reference FROM sepa_orders WHERE club_id=? ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 100',[$a['club_id']])->fetchAll();}
 /** Complete, bounded catalogue; original snapshots are loaded only by get(). */
 public function ordersPage(mixed $page=1,mixed $search='',mixed $state=''):array{
  $a=$this->access();if((!is_int($page)&&!is_string($page))||!preg_match('/^[1-9][0-9]{0,6}$/D',(string)$page)||(int)$page>1000000)throw new DomainException('Auftragsseite prüfen.');
  if(!is_string($search)||!mb_check_encoding($search,'UTF-8')||mb_strlen($search)>200||!is_string($state)||!in_array($state,['','prepared','approved','exported','submitted','cancelled'],true))throw new DomainException('Auftragssuche prüfen.');
  $search=trim($search);$where='club_id=?';$args=[$a['club_id']];if($state!==''){$where.=' AND state=?';$args[]=$state;}
  if($search!==''){$where.=" AND (id LIKE ? ESCAPE '!' OR collection_date LIKE ? ESCAPE '!' OR bank_reference LIKE ? ESCAPE '!')";$pattern='%'.strtr($search,['!'=>'!!','%'=>'!%','_'=>'!_']).'%';array_push($args,$pattern,$pattern,$pattern);}
  $total=(int)$this->q('SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sepa_orders WHERE '.$where,$args)->fetchColumn();$pages=max(1,(int)ceil($total/6));$page=min((int)$page,$pages);$offset=($page-1)*6;
  $rows=$this->q('SELECT id,collection_date,state,total_cents,version,created_at,bank_reference FROM sepa_orders WHERE '.$where.' ORDER BY created_at DESC,id DESC LIMIT 6 OFFSET '.$offset,$args)->fetchAll();
  return compact('rows','total','page','pages','search','state');
 }
 public function get(string $id):array{$a=$this->access();$r=$this->q('SELECT * FROM sepa_orders WHERE club_id=? AND id=?',[$a['club_id'],$id])->fetch();if(!$r)throw new DomainException('SEPA-Auftrag nicht verfügbar.');$r['items']=$this->q('SELECT i.*,c.name,rr.transaction_id return_transaction,rt.reversal_of return_original FROM sepa_order_items i JOIN contacts c ON c.club_id=i.club_id AND c.id=i.contact_id LEFT JOIN sepa_return_records rr ON rr.club_id=i.club_id AND rr.item_id=i.id LEFT JOIN finance_transactions rt ON rt.club_id=rr.club_id AND rt.id=rr.transaction_id WHERE i.club_id=? AND i.order_id=? ORDER BY c.name,i.id',[$a['club_id'],$id])->fetchAll();return $r;}
 public function candidates():array{$a=$this->access();return $this->q("SELECT e.id,e.display_number,e.counterparty,e.amount_cents,e.due_date FROM finance_entries e WHERE e.club_id=? AND e.kind='contribution' AND e.status='open' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sepa_order_items i WHERE i.club_id=e.club_id AND i.entry_id=e.id AND i.state='active') ORDER BY e.due_date,e.id LIMIT 500",[$a['club_id']])->fetchAll();}
 public function candidatePage(mixed $page=1,mixed $search='',mixed $move=''):array{
  $a=$this->access();if((!is_int($page)&&!is_string($page))||!preg_match('/^[1-9][0-9]{0,6}$/D',(string)$page)||(int)$page>1000000||!is_string($search)||!mb_check_encoding($search,'UTF-8')||mb_strlen($search)>200||!is_string($move)||!in_array($move,['','next','previous','search','clear','all'],true))throw new DomainException('Rechnungsauswahl prüfen.');
  $page=(int)$page;if($move==='next')$page=min(1000000,$page+1);elseif($move==='previous')$page=max(1,$page-1);elseif($move==='search')$page=1;
  $search=trim($search);$where="e.club_id=? AND e.kind='contribution' AND e.status='open' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sepa_order_items i WHERE i.club_id=e.club_id AND i.entry_id=e.id AND i.state='active')";$args=[$a['club_id']];
  if($search!==''){$where.=" AND (e.display_number LIKE ? ESCAPE '!' OR e.counterparty LIKE ? ESCAPE '!')";$pattern='%'.strtr($search,['!'=>'!!','%'=>'!%','_'=>'!_']).'%';array_push($args,$pattern,$pattern);}
  $total=(int)$this->q('SELECT COUNT(*) FROM finance_entries e WHERE '.$where,$args)->fetchColumn();$pages=max(1,(int)ceil($total/6));$page=min($page,$pages);$offset=($page-1)*6;
  $rows=$this->q('SELECT e.id,e.display_number,e.counterparty,e.amount_cents,e.due_date FROM finance_entries e WHERE '.$where.' ORDER BY e.due_date,e.id LIMIT 6 OFFSET '.$offset,$args)->fetchAll();return compact('rows','total','page','pages','search');
 }
 /** Preserve own choices across pages; never silently drop stale or foreign choices. */
 public function selection(mixed $entries):array{
  $a=$this->access();if(!is_array($entries)||count($entries)>500)throw new DomainException('Bis zu 500 Beitragsrechnungen auswählen.');
  foreach($entries as$id)if(!is_string($id)||!preg_match('/^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]{1,128}$/D',$id))throw new DomainException('Rechnungsauswahl prüfen.');$entries=array_values(array_unique($entries));if(!$entries)return[];
  $rows=$this->q("SELECT id FROM finance_entries WHERE club_id=? AND kind='contribution' AND id IN (".implode(',',array_fill(0,count($entries),'?')).')',[$a['club_id'],...$entries])->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_COLUMN);if(count($rows)!==count($entries))throw new DomainException('Eine ausgewählte Beitragsrechnung ist nicht verfügbar.');return $entries;
 }
 private function snapshot(array $entries,string $account,string $collection,string $notice):array{
  $a=$this->access();BankImport::date($collection);BankImport::date($notice);if($notice>date('Y-m-d')||$collection<date('Y-m-d',strtotime('+1 day'))||strtotime($collection)<strtotime($notice.' +14 days'))throw new DomainException('Einzugstag in der Zukunft wählen, mindestens 14 Tage nach der bereits erfolgten Vorabinformation.');
  $f=new Finance($this->db,$this->actor);$bank=$f->requireActiveAccount($account);if($bank['kind']!=='offline')throw new DomainException('Einzugskonto muss ein Bankkonto sein.');$settings=new Settings($this->db,$this->actor);$creditor=$settings->section('bank')['data'];if(($creditor['account_id']??'')!==$account)throw new DomainException('Das Einzugskonto zuerst in der Vereinsbankverbindung hinterlegen.');$creditor['iban']=Iban::normalize($creditor['iban']??'');if(!str_starts_with($creditor['iban'],'DE'))throw new DomainException('Dieser vorbereitete CORE-Ablauf unterstützt ein deutsches Vereinskonto.');
  $entries=$this->selection($entries);sort($entries,SORT_STRING);if(!$entries)throw new DomainException('1 bis 500 Beitragsrechnungen auswählen.');$items=[];$total=0;
  foreach($entries as $id){if(!is_string($id))throw new DomainException('Rechnungsauswahl prüfen.');$e=$f->entry($id);if($e['kind']!=='contribution'||$e['payment_state']!=='open'||$e['allocated_cents']||$e['remaining_cents']<=0)throw new DomainException('Nur offene, noch nicht teilweise bezahlte Beitragsrechnungen auswählen.');$notes=json_decode($e['notes'],true);$person=is_array($notes)?($notes['payer']??''):'';if(!is_string($person)||$person==='')throw new DomainException('Der beitragszahlende Mensch muss der Rechnung eindeutig zugeordnet sein.');
   $mandate=$this->vault->mandateForCollection($person);if(!str_starts_with($mandate['bank']['iban'],'DE'))throw new DomainException('Dieser CORE-Export unterstützt derzeit deutsche Mitgliedskonten.');$total+=(int)$e['remaining_cents'];if($total>100000000000)throw new DomainException('Auftragssumme zu groß.');$items[]=['entry_id'=>$id,'entry_version'=>(int)$e['version'],'number'=>$e['display_number'],'name'=>$e['counterparty'],'cents'=>(int)$e['remaining_cents'],'mandate'=>$mandate];
  }return ['account'=>$account,'creditor'=>$creditor,'collection_date'=>$collection,'notice_date'=>$notice,'items'=>$items,'total_cents'=>$total];
 }
 public function preview(array $entries,string $account,string $collection,string $notice):array{$s=$this->snapshot($entries,$account,$collection,$notice);return ['hash'=>hash('sha256',json_encode($s,JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR)),'total_cents'=>$s['total_cents'],'count'=>count($s['items']),'items'=>array_map(fn($i)=>['entry_id'=>$i['entry_id'],'number'=>$i['number'],'name'=>$i['name'],'cents'=>$i['cents'],'iban_masked'=>substr($i['mandate']['bank']['iban'],0,2).' •••• '.substr($i['mandate']['bank']['iban'],-4)],$s['items'])];}
 public function prepare(array $entries,string $account,string $collection,string $notice,string $expected,string $key):string{
  if(!preg_match('/^[a-f0-9]{32}$/D',$key))throw new DomainException('Auftragsformular neu öffnen.');return $this->tx(function()use($entries,$account,$collection,$notice,$expected,$key){$a=$this->access();$old=$this->q('SELECT id,snapshot_hash FROM sepa_orders WHERE club_id=? AND request_key=?',[$a['club_id'],$key])->fetch();if($old){if(!hash_equals($old['snapshot_hash'],$expected))throw new DomainException('Auftragsformular bereits anders verwendet.');return $old['id'];}$s=$this->snapshot($entries,$account,$collection,$notice);$hash=hash('sha256',json_encode($s,JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR));if(!hash_equals($hash,$expected))throw new DomainException('Rechnung, Bankdaten oder Mandat verändert. Vorschau erneut prüfen.');
   foreach($s['items'] as $item)if($this->q("SELECT 1 FROM sepa_order_items WHERE club_id=? AND entry_id=? AND state='active'",[$a['club_id'],$item['entry_id']])->fetchColumn())throw new DomainException('Eine Rechnung ist bereits in einem laufenden Lastschriftauftrag.');
   $id=bin2hex(random_bytes(16));$s['created_at']=gmdate('Y-m-d\TH:i:s\Z');$s['id']=$id;$s['xml']=self::xml($s);$this->q("INSERT INTO sepa_orders(club_id,id,account_id,collection_date,notice_date,state,created_by,created_at,request_key,snapshot_hash,sealed_snapshot,total_cents) VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,'prepared',?,?,?,?,?,?)",[$a['club_id'],$id,$account,$collection,$notice,$a['id'],$s['created_at'],$key,$hash,$this->vault->sealCollection($id,$s),$s['total_cents']]);
   foreach($s['items'] as $index=>$item)$this->q("INSERT INTO sepa_order_items VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,'active',?)",[$a['club_id'],bin2hex(random_bytes(16)),$id,$item['entry_id'],$item['mandate']['contact_id'],$item['cents'],$item['mandate']['version'],$item['mandate']['reference'],'KH'.substr($id,0,24).'-'.($index+1)]);$this->audit('sepa.order.prepared',$id,1);return $id;
  });
 }
 private function current(array $order):array{$s=$this->vault->openCollection($order['id'],$order['sealed_snapshot']);$now=$this->snapshot(array_column($s['items'],'entry_id'),$s['account'],$s['collection_date'],$s['notice_date']);if(!hash_equals($order['snapshot_hash'],hash('sha256',json_encode($now,JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR))))throw new DomainException('Auftrag hat veränderte Rechnungen, Bankdaten oder Mandate. Neu vorbereiten.');return $s;}
 /** Return the immutable, revalidated payload for a direct FinTS submission. */
 public function fintsPayload(string $id,int $version):array{$this->office($this->actor);$r=$this->get($id);if($r['state']!=='approved'||(int)$r['version']!==$version)throw new DomainException('Nur ein aktuell freigegebener Lastschriftauftrag kann über FinTS gesendet werden.');$f=new Finance($this->db,$this->actor);if(!(int)($f->accountSettings($r['account_id'])['fints_write']??0))throw new DomainException('FinTS-Schreiben ist für dieses Einzugskonto noch gesperrt. In den Kontoeinstellungen „Erlaubt“ auswählen.');$s=$this->current($r);$office=$this->office((string)$r['approved_by']);if((int)$office['version']!==(int)$r['office_version'])throw new DomainException('Freigabeamt geändert. Auftrag neu prüfen.');return ['order_id'=>$r['id'],'order_version'=>(int)$r['version'],'account_id'=>$r['account_id'],'source_iban'=>$s['creditor']['iban'],'xml'=>$s['xml'],'reference'=>'FinTS SEPA CORE KH'.$r['id']];}
 /** Mark only a bank-confirmed FinTS result as submitted; no contribution is paid here. */
 public function markFintsSubmitted(string $id,int $version,string $reference):void{$reference=trim($reference);if($reference===''||mb_strlen($reference)>200)throw new DomainException('Bankbestätigung prüfen.');$this->tx(function()use($id,$version,$reference){$a=$this->access();$this->office($this->actor);$r=$this->get($id);if($r['state']!=='approved'||(int)$r['version']!==$version)throw new DomainException('Lastschriftauftrag wurde bereits verarbeitet oder geändert.');$this->current($r);$this->office((string)$r['approved_by']);$this->q("UPDATE sepa_orders SET state='submitted',bank_reference=?,version=version+1 WHERE club_id=? AND id=?",[$reference,$a['club_id'],$id]);$this->audit('sepa.order.fints_submitted',$id,$version+1);});}
 public function approve(string $id,int $version):void{$this->tx(function()use($id,$version){$a=$this->access();$r=$this->get($id);if($r['state']!=='prepared'||(int)$r['version']!==$version)throw new DomainException('Unveränderten vorbereiteten Auftrag wählen.');$this->current($r);$office=$this->office($this->actor);$this->q("UPDATE sepa_orders SET state='approved',approved_by=?,approved_at=?,office_version=?,version=version+1 WHERE club_id=? AND id=?",[$a['id'],gmdate('c'),$office['version'],$a['club_id'],$id]);$this->audit('sepa.order.approved',$id,$version+1);});}
 public function export(string $id,int $version):string{return $this->tx(function()use($id,$version){$a=$this->access();$r=$this->get($id);if(!in_array($r['state'],['approved','exported'],true)||(int)$r['version']!==$version)throw new DomainException('Zuerst den aktuellen Zahlungsauftrag freigeben.');$s=$this->current($r);if((int)$this->office($r['approved_by'])['version']!==(int)$r['office_version'])throw new DomainException('Freigabeamt geändert.');if($r['state']==='approved'){$this->q("UPDATE sepa_orders SET state='exported',exported_at=?,version=version+1 WHERE club_id=? AND id=?",[gmdate('c'),$a['club_id'],$id]);$this->audit('sepa.order.exported',$id,$version+1);}return $s['xml'];});}
 public function submitted(string $id,int $version,string $reference):void{$reference=trim($reference);if($reference===''||strlen($reference)>200)throw new DomainException('Tatsächliche Bankbestätigung / Auftragsnummer eingeben.');$this->tx(function()use($id,$version,$reference){$a=$this->access();$r=$this->get($id);if($r['state']!=='exported'||(int)$r['version']!==$version)throw new DomainException('Unveränderten exportierten Auftrag auswählen.');$this->q("UPDATE sepa_orders SET state='submitted',bank_reference=?,version=version+1 WHERE club_id=? AND id=?",[$reference,$a['club_id'],$id]);$this->audit('sepa.order.externally_submitted',$id,$version+1);});}
 public function cancel(string $id,int $version):void{$this->tx(function()use($id,$version){$a=$this->access();$r=$this->get($id);if(!in_array($r['state'],['prepared','approved'],true)||(int)$r['version']!==$version)throw new DomainException('Bereits exportierte Aufträge zuerst bei der Bank klären; nicht still erneut einziehen.');$this->q("UPDATE sepa_orders SET state='cancelled',version=version+1 WHERE club_id=? AND id=?",[$a['club_id'],$id]);$this->q("UPDATE sepa_order_items SET state='cancelled' WHERE club_id=? AND order_id=?",[$a['club_id'],$id]);$this->audit('sepa.order.cancelled',$id,$version+1);});}
 public function recordReturn(string $item,string $transaction,string $reason,?string $document=null):void{
  $reason=trim($reason);if($reason===''||strlen($reason)>500)throw new DomainException('Rücklastschriftgrund angeben.');$entryId=$this->tx(function()use($item,$transaction,$reason,$document){$a=$this->access();$i=$this->q('SELECT i.*,o.account_id,o.state order_state FROM sepa_order_items i JOIN sepa_orders o ON o.club_id=i.club_id AND o.id=i.order_id WHERE i.club_id=? AND i.id=?',[$a['club_id'],$item])->fetch();if(!$i||$i['state']!=='active'||!in_array($i['order_state'],['exported','submitted'],true))throw new DomainException('Aktuellen eingereichten Lastschriftposten auswählen.');$f=new Finance($this->db,$this->actor);$t=$f->transactionDetail($transaction);if($t['account_id']!==$i['account_id']||(int)$t['cents']!==-(int)$i['cents']||$t['reversal_of']||$t['reversed_on']||$t['allocated_cents'])throw new DomainException('Unzugeordneten Rücklastschriftumsatz auf demselben Konto und mit genauem Einzugsbetrag auswählen. Gebühren separat erfassen.');if($document)(new Documents($this->db,$this->actor))->document($document);
   $links=array_values(array_filter($f->allocations($i['entry_id']),fn($l)=>!$l['voided_at']&&!$l['reversed_on']&&!$l['reversal_of']));
   if(count($links)===1&&(int)$links[0]['cents']===(int)$i['cents']){
    $positive=$f->transactionDetail($links[0]['transaction_id']);$positiveLinks=array_values(array_filter($f->allocations($positive['id'],true),fn($l)=>!$l['voided_at']));
    if(count($positiveLinks)===1&&(int)$positive['cents']===(int)$i['cents']&&$positive['account_id']===$i['account_id'])$f->reconcileReturnedDebitLocked($i['entry_id'],$positive['id'],$transaction,$reason);
   }
   $this->q('INSERT INTO sepa_return_records VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)',[$a['club_id'],bin2hex(random_bytes(16)),$item,$transaction,$reason,$document,$a['id'],gmdate('c')]);$this->q("UPDATE sepa_order_items SET state='returned' WHERE club_id=? AND id=?",[$a['club_id'],$item]);$this->audit('sepa.return.recorded',$item,1);
   return $i['entry_id'];
  });DonationPreparation::afterSource($this->db,$this->actor,'entry',$entryId);
 }
 public static function xml(array $s):string{
  $d=new DOMDocument('1.0','UTF-8');$d->formatOutput=true;$ns='urn:iso:std:iso:20022:tech:xsd:pain.008.001.08';$root=$d->createElementNS($ns,'Document');$d->appendChild($root);$add=static function($parent,string $name,?string $value=null)use($d,$ns){$n=$d->createElementNS($ns,$name);if($value!==null)$n->appendChild($d->createTextNode($value));$parent->appendChild($n);return $n;};
  $init=$add($root,'CstmrDrctDbtInitn');$header=$add($init,'GrpHdr');$add($header,'MsgId','KH'.$s['id']);$add($header,'CreDtTm',$s['created_at']);$add($header,'NbOfTxs',(string)count($s['items']));$add($header,'CtrlSum',Finance::decimal($s['total_cents']));$add($add($header,'InitgPty'),'Nm',mb_substr($s['creditor']['holder'],0,70));
  $payment=$add($init,'PmtInf');$add($payment,'PmtInfId','KH'.$s['id']);$add($payment,'PmtMtd','DD');$add($payment,'BtchBookg','false');$add($payment,'NbOfTxs',(string)count($s['items']));$add($payment,'CtrlSum',Finance::decimal($s['total_cents']));$type=$add($payment,'PmtTpInf');$add($add($type,'SvcLvl'),'Cd','SEPA');$add($add($type,'LclInstrm'),'Cd','CORE');$add($type,'SeqTp','RCUR');$add($payment,'ReqdColltnDt',$s['collection_date']);
  $add($add($payment,'Cdtr'),'Nm',mb_substr($s['items'][0]['mandate']['terms']['creditor_name'],0,70));$add($add($add($payment,'CdtrAcct'),'Id'),'IBAN',$s['creditor']['iban']);$add($add($add($add($payment,'CdtrAgt'),'FinInstnId'),'Othr'),'Id','NOTPROVIDED');$add($payment,'ChrgBr','SLEV');
  $other=$add($add($add($add($payment,'CdtrSchmeId'),'Id'),'PrvtId'),'Othr');$add($other,'Id',$s['items'][0]['mandate']['terms']['creditor_id']);$add($add($other,'SchmeNm'),'Prtry','SEPA');
  foreach($s['items'] as $index=>$item){$m=$item['mandate'];$tx=$add($payment,'DrctDbtTxInf');$add($add($tx,'PmtId'),'EndToEndId','KH'.substr($s['id'],0,24).'-'.($index+1));$amount=$add($tx,'InstdAmt',Finance::decimal($item['cents']));$amount->setAttribute('Ccy','EUR');$mandate=$add($add($tx,'DrctDbtTx'),'MndtRltdInf');$add($mandate,'MndtId',$m['reference']);$add($mandate,'DtOfSgntr',$m['signed_on']);$add($mandate,'AmdmntInd','false');$add($add($add($add($tx,'DbtrAgt'),'FinInstnId'),'Othr'),'Id','NOTPROVIDED');$add($add($tx,'Dbtr'),'Nm',mb_substr($m['bank']['holder'],0,70));$add($add($add($tx,'DbtrAcct'),'Id'),'IBAN',$m['bank']['iban']);$add($add($tx,'RmtInf'),'Ustrd',mb_substr($item['number'].' Mitgliedsbeitrag',0,140));}
  $errors=libxml_use_internal_errors(true);try{if(!$d->schemaValidate(dirname(dirname(__DIR__, 2),2).'/banking/schemas/pain.008.001.08.xsd'))throw new DomainException('Die erzeugte Bankdatei entspricht nicht dem SEPA-Format. Der Auftrag wurde nicht erstellt.');}finally{libxml_clear_errors();libxml_use_internal_errors($errors);}
  return $d->saveXML();
 }
}
